# Installed from PyPI after requirements-torch.txt.
# Exact versions of everything are in requirements-lock.txt (written by tools/backup.sh).
lerobot[feetech]==0.4.4
# libcudss.so.0 for the Jetson torch build; env.sh puts it on LD_LIBRARY_PATH
nvidia-cudss-cu12==0.8.0.10
# OAK-D depth camera (doctor, hardware snapshot)
depthai==3.11.0
# ROS 2 Humble's message libraries are built for numpy 1.x and fail to load
# under numpy 2, and our ROS nodes run in this environment. OpenCV 4.11+
# requires numpy 2, so hold it at 4.10 (LeRobot allows >=4.9).
# Known, accepted conflict: rerun-sdk (LeRobot's live viewer for teleop and
# dataset recording, which we do not use) declares numpy>=2.
numpy<2
opencv-python-headless<4.11
